author: AbusiveUser
body:
Hello! today I will be introducing a new map called Abandoned Canyon for the new gamemode called 'Sky Wars'. I built this map with some friends and we hope you like our work in this map.
I won't explain the objective of this map because it is pretty simple to understand.

Islands:
  • Primary Islands: You will find 8 islands with 3 chests.
  • Secondary Islands: You will find 8 islands with 1 chest. (Islands with chest are in front of primary Islands)
  • Middle Island: You will find 4 chest in Middle and 2 hidden chest at the top.


Creator: AbusiveUser
Contributors: Junr & Hupi
Server hosted by: Cloudy (hosted by Shinydialga)
Gamemode: Sky Wars
Recommended Size:
  • FFA: 8 players per Island
  • Teams: 16 players (2 per island)
Building Time: 3 days.
Feedback: None

- - - - - - - - - - - - - -
  • Full Imgur Album: http://imgur.com/a/QylhB  (Updated)
  • Download: Sorry, download will not be provided.
Well, that's all for today, remember that feedback is always appreciated and it will help me improve in our future maps. If you have any questions about my map, ask in the comments and I will try my best to answer quickly.
Thanks, ~Abusive!
